Clarification in Public Interest

DBL Recruitment Process

  • It has been brought to our attention that certain unscrupulous elements are sending out false emails purporting to be from Dilip Buildcon Limited (“DBL”). The emails ask the recipient to appear for a face-to-face interview for a job opening with DBL and to deposit a certain amount as a refundable interview security in a designated bank account. The emails are falsely stated to be from officials of the HR Department of DBL.
  • DBL has not sent out any such emails. Please note that DBL, as a policy, does not collect any money as a pre-employment requirement. DBL and its affiliate companies bear no responsibility for amounts being deposited / withdrawn therefrom in response to such emails:
  • These communications may carry the ID or domain name of DBL (or a deceptively similar name) to make it look authentic. DBL is taking appropriate steps to tackle the issue. As a vigilant jobseeker, please look out for the following pointers to identify the fraudulent emails:
  • DBL does not ask for any money from the candidate at any stage of the recruitment process
  • A fraudulent email may mention the bank account number of an individual or the account details would be given upon calling up on the number mentioned in the fraudulent mail. In any case the bank account would not be in the name of “Dilip Buildcon Limited.”
  • DBL letters will address job applicants with proper salutations including the last name (not with generic greetings)
  • Please check if you receive calls from the DBL registered numbers or from a private number
  • We advise candidates not to respond to any fraudulent emails and not to make any payments. In case of any doubt please contact 0755-4029999

To protect passers-by from hazards on roads and highways, DBL undertakes stringent safety measures. 

Barricades erected on either side of the carriageway closed to traffic are designed to resist violation and are painted in monochrome stripes. Red lanterns or warning lights are mounted on the barricades at night and are lit through the night.

Where deviations in traffic are expected, the new channel is clearly highlighted with pavement markings or painted drums. At night, the passage is delineated with lanterns or other suitable light source.

One-way traffic operation is established whenever traffic passes through a carriageway inadequate for two-lane traffic. This is done with the help of temporary traffic signals or flagmen positioned on the carriageway. For regulation of traffic, the flagmen are equipped with red and green flags and lanterns/ lights.

On both sides, suitable regulatory/warning signs as approved by the engineer are installed for the guidance of road users. On each approach, at least two signs are put up, one close to the point where transition of carriageway begins and the other 120m away. The signs are of approved design and of reflective type, as directed by the engineer.

A free Health Check Up Camp for all Dilipbuildcon employees , their families and nearby villagers were organized in 31st December 2020 at DBL Site Camp was organized in Sanjeevan Multispecialty Hospital & Research Institute . 

District, Maharashtra. Dr. Nijamudeen Ansari, M.D. Civil Surgeon of Hospital arrived at the camp at 11:00 PM. Patients discussed various issue of health with the doctors. Free Physical examination along with free Blood Sugar, Blood Pressure, CBC, HBSAG, THIRODE TEST, SICKLE TEST, TB SPUTUM TEST, HIV/AIDS.

Geo Green is an initiative taken by DBL for environmental sustainability and to protect the soil from either side of under construction roads from eroding. The road construction process displaces a lot of soil and loosens earth, impacting the quality of land in the surroundings. To prevent this from happening, DBL plants trees and grows grass on dividers, beautifying the roads in the process. 

DBL constantly conducts fire safety training in villages around project areas. Often these events are facilitated by local police and government departments. Some examples are below:

Project: Kawardha – Simga
Awareness of Fire Safety imparted to students of Government Middle School, Bemitra, District, Raipur, Chhattisgarh. Road Safety Week celebrated with District Police Department.

Project: Maholia – Bahagora
Awareness of traffic rules imparted to students of Kasturba Gandhi Girls School, Dhalumghar, District East Sindhbhum, Jharkhand

Project: Chas – Ramgarh
Awareness of traffic rules imparted to students of Government Higher Secondary School Peterbar, District Bokaro, Jharkhand Project: Jabalpur – Mandla Description: Awareness of traffic rules imparted to students of Government Middle School Bichiya, District Mandla

DBL celebrated Swachhta Pakhwada successfully across all the sites of DBL with full zeal and enthusiasm from 1st January to 15th January

During the Pakhwada different activities undertaken are as follows: 

  • DBL volunteers educate slum dwellers about the necessity of self-hygiene, community hygiene, cleanliness and preventive measures against about the dengue & malaria
  • Safai Abhiyan at nearby commercial area and markets, roads etc.
  • Safai Abhiyan in the school premises and class rooms.
  • Seminar to sensitize the Students regarding environmental issues.
  • Sensitize people of the locality about cleanliness of public places.
  • Meetings/lectures on related themes
  • Workshops on related themes.
  • Cleaning of public wells, ponds and rivers of the locality.
  • Awareness classes on Water conservation and recharging measures
  • Tree plantation
  • Educating the Waste Management practices like- separate bins for degradable and biodegradable wastes.
  • Carry out campaign against plastic and leaf burning and their proper disposal
  • Conduct of quizzes, elocution, painting, essay competitions etc.

A free Health Check Up Camp for all Dilip Buildcon employees, their families and nearby villagers were organized in 05.07.2018 at DBL Site Camp was organized in association with Thumbakuppam Govt. Hospital, Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh. 

A team of 4 members from Hospital including one MBBS, DPM (Psychiatrist), arrived at the camp at 11:30 PM. He discussed various issue of health with the doctors. During this camp free Physical Health Checkup along with Malaria examination was conducted. The team also rendered awareness regarding HIV and AIDS.

DBL reiterates it’s commitment towards environmental sustainability. As a gesture of that commitment, World Environment Day is celebrated across project sites.

Some examples below:

Project: Jabalpur – Shahpura – Patan
Tree plantation activity done at various locations at the project site

Project: Guna – Biaora
Tree plantation drive, cleanliness of road side eateries/ establishments, waste reduction training, construction site hygiene training, waste segregation training, and drain & carriageway cleaning activities done at various locations at project site.

Project: Ghaghra Bridge-Varanasi
Tree plantation drive, cleanliness of road side eateries/ establishments, waste reduction training, construction site hygiene training, waste segregation training, and drain & carriageway cleaning activities done at various locations at project site.
